title: OmniBuild Wand
description: Large-scale building wand, Five Modes (Load/Fill/Copy/Replace/Move). Collect bricks and automatically build from litematica! | 全能建造杖 — 填充/复制/替换/移动四模式 + 工地系统，为大规模建造而生
body:
OmniBuild Wand · 全能建造杖
为大规模建造而生的 Fabric 建筑手杖 · A Fabric building wand built for large-scale construction
Minecraft 26.1.2 · Fabric ｜ 必需 / Required: Fabric API · Litematica · MaLiLib

![OmniBuild Wand](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/worksite-building.png) > 🌐 中文教程在上半部分，English guide is in the second half below. · [GitHub](https://github.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand) --- # 🇨🇳 中文教程 ## 📦 安装 1. 安装 **Fabric Loader** 与 **Fabric API**。 2. 安装 **Litematica** + **MaLiLib**（蓝图与幽灵预览所需，**必需**）。 3. 把 `omnibuild-wand-x.x.x.jar` 放进 `.minecraft/mods/`。 ## 🛠️ 合成 钻石 ×1 + 烈焰棒 ×2，斜向排布（`D`=钻石，`B`=烈焰棒）： ``` · · D · B · B · · ``` ![合成配方](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/crafting.png) ## 🎮 基础概念 - **手持手杖右键** ＝ 选角 / 执行。多数操作是「右键选第一个角 → 再右键选对角 → 完成」。 - 按 **`N`** 在五种模式间循环：**填充 → 复制/粘贴 → 替换 → 移动 → 供料链接**。 - 按 **`V`** 在 **方形选区 ↔ 智能选区** 间切换。 - **`Shift` + 右键** ＝ 重置当前选区。 - 生存模式会**真实扣除背包材料**（含**潜影盒**）；材料不够时可改用「工地」慢慢囤料建造。 ## 🟦 填充模式 框选两角，把范围内的空气填成手里的方块。 ![填充模式](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/fill.png) ## 📋 复制 / 粘贴模式 右键选两个角框住结构（记录到剪贴板），到别处右键**粘贴**；粘贴前可按 **`R` 旋转**、**`B` 镜像**。 ![复制模式](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/copy.png) ## ♻️ 替换模式 把**要替换成**的方块放手里 → 右键选两角 → 第三次右键**点要被替换掉的方块**，范围内同类全部替换。 ![替换前](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/replace-before.png) ![替换后](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/replace-after.png) ## 🚚 移动模式 右键选两角框住建筑 → 右键目标位置**整体移动**（原地清空），支持 `R` / `B`。 ![移动前](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/move-before.png) ![移动后](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/move-after.png) ## 🧠 智能选区 按 **`V`** 切到智能选区，右键一个方块**自动识别整片连续建筑**并锁定，再次右键确认执行（复制 / 替换 / 移动 都能用）。上限可在 `/wand settings` 调。 ![智能选区](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/smart-selection.png) ## 🏗️ 工地系统（招牌功能） 大型工程不想一次掏空仓库？把它变成「工地」，慢慢囤料、自动施工。 1. 材料不足会**自动转为工地**，地面立起**工地牌**。 ![生成工地](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/worksite-created.png) 2. **右键工地牌**打开管理站，把材料丢进去「存入材料」。管理站还有「**取回材料**」（退回背包）与「**从箱子补料**」两个按钮。 ![工地管理站](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/worksite-dashboard.png) 3. 点「**开始施工**」，工地**自动逐块建造**直到完工。 ![自动建造中](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/worksite-building.png) ## 🔗 供料链接（接箱子自动供料）★ 1.1.0 新增 懒得手动搬料？把附近的箱子接上，工地施工时**自动取料**。 1. 按 `N` 切到 **供料链接** 模式。 2. 右键框选两个角，把装材料的**箱子 / 木桶 / 潜影盒**圈进去（**箱子里的潜影盒也算**）。 3. 再**右键工地牌**完成链接（提示「已链接 N 个容器」）。 4. 点「**从箱子补料**」或直接**开始施工**——施工时每秒自动从这些容器取料。 > 🛡️ 安全机制：每个容器、每种材料**至少保留 1 个**，绝不抽空箱子。 ## 📐 Litematica 蓝图导入 手持手杖输入 `/wand load <蓝图文件路径>`，右键地面**生成对应工地**，之后流程同上。 ![加载蓝图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/blueprint-load.png) ## ⌨️ 按键速查 | 按键 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | 右键 | 选角 / 执行 | | `Shift` + 右键 | 重置选区 | | `R` / `B` | 旋转 / 镜像 | | `N` | 切换模式（填充/复制/替换/移动/供料链接） | | `V` | 方形 / 智能选区 切换 | | `/wand settings` | 打开设置 | | `/wand load ` | 加载蓝图 | --- # 🇬🇧 English Guide ## 📦 Installation 1. Install **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API**. 2. Install **Litematica** + **MaLiLib** (**required** — blueprints & ghost preview). 3. Drop `omnibuild-wand-x.x.x.jar` into `.minecraft/mods/`. ## 🛠️ Crafting 1× Diamond + 2× Blaze Rod, diagonal (`D`=Diamond, `B`=Blaze Rod): ``` · · D · B · B · · ``` ![Crafting recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/crafting.png) ## 🎮 Core concepts - **Right-click** = pick a corner / execute (corner 1 → opposite corner → done). - Press **`N`** to cycle five modes: **Fill → Copy/Paste → Replace → Move → Supply Link**. - Press **`V`** to toggle **Box ↔ Smart Selection**. **`Shift` + Right-click** resets. - In Survival it **consumes real materials** (including **shulker boxes**). Short on materials? Use a *worksite*. ## 🟦 Fill Mode Right-click two corners; the air in the box fills with the block in your hand. ![Fill mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/fill.png) ## 📋 Copy / Paste Mode Right-click two corners around a structure, then right-click elsewhere to paste. **`R`** rotate / **`B`** flip before pasting. ![Copy mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/copy.png) ## ♻️ Replace Mode Hold the **replacement** block → two corners → third right-click **on the block to replace**. All matching blocks swap. ![Replace before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/replace-before.png) ![Replace after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/replace-after.png) ## 🚚 Move Mode Two corners around a build → right-click target to relocate it (source cleared). `R` / `B` supported. ![Move before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/move-before.png) ![Move after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/move-after.png) ## 🧠 Smart Selection Press **`V`**, right-click one block and it auto-detects the whole contiguous structure; right-click again to confirm. Works with Copy / Replace / Move. ![Smart Selection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/smart-selection.png) ## 🏗️ Worksite System (headline feature) Turn a big build into a *worksite*: a post appears, right-click it to open the dashboard, **Deposit** materials, then **Start Construction** — it builds itself block by block. The dashboard also has **Withdraw Materials** and **Pull from Chests** buttons. ![Worksite created](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/worksite-created.png) ![Worksite dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/worksite-dashboard.png) ![Auto-building](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/worksite-building.png) ## 🔗 Supply Link (auto-feed from chests) ★ New in 1.1.0 Don't want to haul materials by hand? Link nearby chests and the worksite **pulls materials automatically** while building. 1. Press `N` to switch to **Supply Link** mode. 2. Right-click two corners around your **chests / barrels / shulker boxes** (shulkers *inside* chests count too). 3. **Right-click the worksite post** to link ("Linked N containers"). 4. Click **Pull from Chests**, or just **Start Construction** — it pulls every second as it builds. > 🛡️ Safety: each container always keeps **at least one** of every material — chests are never fully emptied. ## 📐 Litematica Blueprint Import Hold the wand, run `/wand load `, then right-click the ground to spawn the matching worksite. ![Load blueprint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand/main/docs/images/blueprint-load.png) ## ⌨️ Controls | Key | Action | | --- | --- | | Right-click | Pick corner / execute | | `Shift` + Right-click | Reset selection | | `R` / `B` | Rotate / Flip | | `N` | Switch mode (Fill/Copy/Replace/Move/Supply Link) | | `V` | Toggle Box / Smart Selection | | `/wand settings` | Open settings | | `/wand load ` | Load a Litematica schematic | --- License: MIT · Source & full README: https://github.com/binyxu/omnibuild-wand
